gen-gf-phudu-gf-mona-sans: Chunky, loud, unmistakably display. Phudu holds one line weight everywhere, so if it's shrunk down, it turns into a tight little stamp beside Mona Sans, whose letters stay wide open.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-monda: Monda reads friendly and uncluttered, with even the tiniest counters kept clear of ink. Phudu does the shouting, its curves flowing in step with its stems, while Monda does the patient work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mooli: Phudu leads with a pen line that holds one width through every curve, loud and a touch playful on its own. Mooli follows with round, open sans letters that stay clear even small.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-murecho: Phudu has no pressure swells anywhere, so the eye never slows down inside a letter. And Murecho, with its s curves flung wide at both ends, gives that blunt confidence a smooth, modern landing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-nanum-gothic: Marker-bold and a bit cheeky. Nanum Gothic takes the other job, leaving wide channels into each counter so the text stays easy to follow, while Phudu handles the attention-grabbing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-national-park: Phudu's lines never swell or thin, as if one ballpoint drew every curve. National Park carries that same pen-that-never-presses idea into rounded plain sans letters with a clearly open side, which is why the two feel related.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-niramit: Niramit brings curves that gape open, giving the text a bright, clean look. Phudu sits above in thick, constant lines, so the two read as loud and quiet cousins.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abori: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal reads open at every curve end. Give that plain sans a little extra size and it stays clear, while Phudu's untapered strokes stay blunt.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Phudu's n arches are as heavy as the stems beside them, giving every letter a blocky, solid build. Noto Sans Cypriot feels lighter and friendlier next to it, its e opening up instead of closing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Phudu draws a constant stroke from the top of each letter to the baseline, which gives it a bold, stamped look. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, so the text feels lighter and more open underneath.
